title: CodeChef: Chef and Instant Noodles
description: Chef has `x` stoves. Each stove can cook 1 packet of noodles in 1 minute. Chef is open for `y` minutes. Find the maximum number of customers Chef can serve if each customer wants exactly 1 packet.
starter_code:
def max_customers(x: int, y: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def max_customers(x: int, y: int) -> int:
    return x * y
explanation: Total capacity equals product of stoves and minutes.
